title.rendered: The Hair Mom | Cosmetology Classes for Students | ESA Accepted

content.rendered:
Student Education at Unity Salon

The Hair Mom

The Hair Mom is the student education program at Unity Salon in Norterra, Phoenix. Hands-on cosmetology boot camps for students interested in the beauty industry, combining in-salon training with foundational theory.

  • ✓ESA Accepted
  • ✓ClassWallet
  • ✓Debit Card

Real Skills, Real Salon

These boot camps are taught by Tamekia Dolan, a licensed cosmetologist and educator with over 25 years of experience, including an educator position at Penrose Academy in Scottsdale. Students learn inside a working salon, not a classroom pretending to be one.

What Students Learn

  • Foundational cosmetology theory, including hair structure and hair types
  • Hands-on techniques with real tools in a professional salon setting
  • Working with curly, textured, and diverse hair types
  • Salon professionalism, client care, and what a career in beauty really looks like
Where Classes Are Held

Unity Salon at The Beauty District (Suite #101), inside The Shops at Norterra. 2480 W Happy Valley Rd, Suite #1205, Phoenix, AZ 85085.

How Families Pay

The Hair Mom is an approved education vendor. Families can use ESA funds through ClassWallet, or pay directly by debit card. You can find our listing on AZ Ed Vendors.

Ask About Classes

Tell us a little about your student and we will follow up with dates, details, and enrollment info.

Braidful is a brand that has been years in the making. The name, brand, and account were originally created in 2020, just before COVID changed so many plans. Like many great ideas, this one had to pause for a season.

Now, Braidful is back, and better than ever.

Through Unity Salon, Braidful brings a fresh, creative approach to braiding for events, activations, special gatherings, and more. It is all about offering braids as part of an experience, not just a service.

content.rendered:
Be Beautiful – With

UNITY SALON

Book Now

Unity Today, Beautiful Forever

Think beautiful, be beautiful. Founded on the notion that you can feel and be completely beautiful, Unity Salon believes in complete beauty inside and out. Whether an initial consultation or a complete transformation, we want you to see and experience your own beauty. We will look to understand you and the needs for your hair so that the love of your hair transforms you.

Hello

I’m Tamekia

Unity Salon was founded by Tamekia Dolan, who has been a licensed hair stylist for over 25 years. Tamekia has a passion for mentoring others, which led her to an educator position at one of the most prestigious schools in Scottsdale, AZ (Penrose Academy). Although Tamekia is a licensed educator, she still pursues continuing education classes around the U.S.

  • Follow
Book Now

Services

What Unity Salon Offers

Innovative Hair Extensions

Tamekia has been doing hair extensions for over 20 years. Unity Salon can utilize extensions to add volume, texture, or dimension to your hair to create your desired transformation. Tamekia is familiar with most techniques, including hand-tied wefts, tape-ins, sew-ins, and cylinders. During a consultation, we will find the right combination of techniques for you.

Haircuts

From DevaCurl specialty haircuts tailored for natural textures to custom cuts designed to fit your unique style, Unity Salon offers precision and care for all. We also provide men’s haircuts and children’s haircuts in a welcoming, professional environment—perfect for the whole family.

Color Specialists

While hair coloring is certainly an art, it’s also rooted in complex science. At Unity Salon, we bring extensive experience with a wide range of hair textures and advanced color techniques, including coloring curly hair, hand painting, foiling, balayage, and precision color retouches. Each service is designed to deliver vibrant, healthy results tailored to your individual style.

  • Women’s Haircuts
  • DevaCurl Haircut
  • Color Retouch
  • All Over Cover
  • Partial Highlight
  • Full Highlight
  • Balayage
  • Men’s Haircut
  • Mizani Relaxer
  • Body Wave
  • Hair Extensions (all extensions require a consultation)
  • Hand Tied Wefts
  • Sew-Ins
  • Tape-Ins
  • Permanent Wave

Serving Clients Throughout Arizona

Unity Salon is located in the heart of Norterra and proudly serves clients across North Phoenix, Anthem, Peoria, Scottsdale — and even Flagstaff. Many of our clients are willing to make the drive because we specialize in curly hair, textured hair, and inclusive care for all hair types. If you’re looking for a salon that truly understands your hair, we’d love to meet you.

What Clients Are Saying

Unity Salon has become a trusted hair salon in Norterra Phoenix, thanks to the consistent care, skill, and warmth that clients experience during every visit. Whether it’s a first haircut for an 8th grade dance, a curly hair transformation, or custom hair extensions, clients describe Tamekia as professional, kind, knowledgeable—and someone who truly listens.

Many guests praise her ability to work with textured, curly, and thick hair, while others highlight her talents in balayage, color correction, and personalized hair care routines. Reviews also note the clean, welcoming environment and the ease of online booking at The Shops at Norterra.

Hello, there!

Ready to Build Unity?

The Unity Group is dedicated to fostering unity across various sectors, including hairstylists, community organizations, schools, and corporations. Our commitment extends beyond providing education; we also engage in supporting those in need. Through sponsorships, we raise funds to facilitate ongoing education for charitable organizations and individuals dedicated to making a difference.

At The Unity Group, our offerings extend well beyond traditional educational services, reflecting our commitment to comprehensive engagement and outreach. Here’s a closer look at the diverse services we provide:

  • Promotional Content Creation: Tailoring content for social media platforms to amplify our message of unity and education.
  • Blogging: Maintaining an informative blog that serves as a resource for insights, updates, and stories that inspire and educate.
  • Webinars: Hosting webinars on a wide range of topics to provide accessible education and foster community discussion.
  • Speaking Engagements: Participating in conferences as speakers to share our expertise, promote unity, and engage with broader audiences.

If you’re interested in our educational services or sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to us.

Contact Unity Salon

Looking for More?

Need more than a form or phone number? If you have additional questions, want to follow our beauty tips, or just feel like exploring what we’re about, you’re always welcome. You can check out our latest blog posts and tutorials for styling advice, behind-the-scenes moments, and community stories that reflect what we stand for.

Thinking about stopping by in person? We’re proudly located inside the Beauty District Salon Suites at Norterra. If you’re in the area, swing by and say hello! We’d love to connect with you — even if it’s just a quick visit to check out the vibe.

Unity Salon is more than a place for hair — it’s a space built on purpose, passion, and community.

UNITY UNIVERSITY

About Tamekia

Unity University offers a program meticulously crafted to embrace and teach the intricate nuances of working with diverse hair types. This initiative reflects my commitment to fostering an inclusive and knowledgeable hair care community. Whether you’re a professional aiming to expand your expertise or an individual passionate about enhancing your hair care practices, this curriculum provides valuable insights and practical knowledge.

With over two decades of experience as a hair care specialist and five years in educational roles, I’ve developed a comprehensive curriculum centered on Hair Diversity. This curriculum, the culmination of my extensive experience and dedication to the craft, caters to various learning environments. Currently, it’s offered across multiple platforms, including salons, professional hair product retailers, and other select venues, ensuring accessibility for those eager to deepen their understanding and skills in hair care.

For more detailed information about the curriculum, enrollment process, or specific inquiries, please reach out. Contact me to explore how Unity University can enrich your professional journey or personal growth in hair care.

Work With me

Cultivating Understanding

The Impact of Hair Diversity Education on Communities

Hair diversity education extends well beyond salons, impacting households and educational institutions alike. It plays a crucial role in environments such as multicultural foster homes, families with adopted children, and schools that may struggle with understanding the myriad hair types enriching our communities. This lack of understanding can lead to insensitivity and hurtful actions.

What I Do

Community & Corporate Education

I address these challenges by leveraging effective communication skills to foster a deeper appreciation for hair diversity. My interventions aim to rectify misconceptions and promote a more inclusive perspective on hair care. By educating individuals in various settings, I enrich their knowledge base and help cultivate environments where diversity is celebrated, and every hair type is respected. This work underscores the power of education in bridging cultural divides and building a more understanding and empathetic society.

Let's Talk

Beyond The Salon

  • Important in multicultural foster homes and families with adopted children.
  • Addresses schools’ misunderstanding of diverse hair types.
  • Aims to correct insensitivity and promote inclusivity.
  • Tamekia uses effective communication to educate and foster appreciation.
  • Cultivates an environment where every hair type is respected.
  • Follow

Get In Touch

      • Email: tamekia@unity.salonUnity Salon

      • Instagram: Unity Salon Instagram
